title: Horticulture and cash crops broaden Gujarat’s agricultural value base, with fruits, vegetables, spices, and plantation crops adding weight beyond field crops
subtitle: Illustrative horticulture and cash-crop mix showing that Gujarat’s agricultural platform is not limited to traditional field crops, but also includes sizable value pools across multiple higher-value crop segments.

chart.annotation: Multiple horticulture and cash-crop segments carry meaningful weight, expanding Gujarat’s value base beyond field crops alone.

insights.text: **Vegetables** lead at **26%**, followed by **Fruits** at **22%** and **Spices** at **18%**, showing material scale across core horticulture segments.
The ranking continues through **Flowers** at **12%**, **Plantation crops** at **10%**, and **Medicinal crops** at **8%**.
This spread across six segments shows Gujarat’s agricultural value base extends beyond traditional field-crop systems into broader market-linked crop categories.
